title: The three new lens agents (L12/L13/L14) are never loaded: an explicit agents array replaces default agents/ scanning and lists only 30 of 33 files, so no full 14-lens round can converge or archive
PreToolUse block for edm-lint-staged-artifacts uses matcher 'git commit', but PreToolUse matchers match tool names only -- the commit-time artifact lint never fires
Step 6 invokes edm-repo-readiness but allowed-tools grants no Bash scope for it, so the readiness scorecard silently never runs
Step 1b.5 consumes a readiness score produced later (Phase 1, dispatched at Step 2) and names no file, state key or command to read it from
file-event hookify rules are unreachable outside an active Phase 6 -- the marker-absent bare exit 0 precedes the edm-hookify call site at :393
Canonical Hookify section still states no evaluator reads the rules and no hook fires because of them, after EDMV4-T43/T45 shipped the evaluator and three blocking consumers

No hookify rule file ships and .claude/edm-hookify/ does not exist -- intentional per the project-owned-directory design, but it means no shipped configuration exercises the hookify blocking path at all
edm-repo-readiness --json has no shipped consumer (only wave8-smoke.sh) -- a documented user-facing CLI affordance, and the obvious acquisition path for the L11-004 fix
edm-hookify list has no in-plugin consumer (only eval is called by the three gates) -- documented user-facing CLI subcommand, not a dead internal contract
stop-event hookify rules evaluate only when at least one initiative is active -- documented at :154-157 with a stated rationale, unlike the undocumented file-event scoping in L11-005
